meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用命令行工具管理 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are managing AI agents via command line

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 增加 OpenCode，把它作为各 agent 组的一个模型提供方，从而接 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等模型。执行时会复制文件、装依赖、重建镜像并同步已有组。
howto.when: 用户要求某个 agent 组改用 OpenCode 作为提供方，或要求接 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等模型时进入；若所需文件都已存在，则跳过安装直接配置。

say.text: 用 OpenCode 给 g1 组接 DeepSeek 模型
say.note: 会更新该组配置并重启。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加 OpenCode，让模型能走 OpenRouter
say.note: 会先补装文件，再配 OpenRouter 上游。

howto.what_en: Adds OpenCode as a NanoClaw agent provider, letting groups use DeepSeek/OpenRouter models. Copies provider files into host/container, pins SDK+CLI, rebuilds the image, and updates existing per-group overlays.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use OpenCode for an agent group, e.g. with DeepSeek/OpenRouter models. If all preflight files are present, installation is skipped and config continues.

say_en.text: Use OpenCode to give group g1 a DeepSeek model
say_en.note: Updates the group config and restarts it.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode to NanoClaw and route models through OpenRouter
say_en.note: Installs missing files, then configures the OpenRouter upstream.
